claims.statement: At n = 2^20 the fixed-base comb in proof.md recovers the BLS12-381 G1 scalar with probability 1. Group operations are the executed EFD schedules dbl-2009-l, add-2007-bl and madd-2007-bl on this curve. Histogram counters and record addresses are two words. Digits are recoded into 1..2^w, so no comb slot is infinity. One radix record pays 334 instructions per pass, including the bucket-offset increment. Total work is at most W = 11740148960245930949733787335886895195 target-group-operation equivalents. The declared score 123142791/1000000 = 123.142791 is a ceiling of log2(W) at resolution 10^(-6). Peak memory is 114494405117176810328844337551868239872 bytes. Preprocessing is 2224346136838462345237332146 reference units and is included in W. Nonuniform advice is 0 bytes.

experiments.purpose: Remeasure the limb schedule on BLS12-381 G1, rebuild W with two-word counters and addresses, check full toy coverage from P0 and A_d, and write one JSON object.
